name: get_all_plm_links
description: INSTEON ONLY. Get all the links in the PLM. A full scan is slow, so a result from the last hour is reused automatically -- pass refresh_plm_links=true only if the customer explicitly asks for a fresh scan. This drives the PLM's serial hardware directly, so it cannot run at the same time as get_dev_links_table/compare_device_links/quick_plm_sanity_check or a second call to itself -- if one of those is already in progress this returns an immediate {"error": ...} rather than waiting; just retry shortly. Params: refresh_plm_links (optional bool, default false).

refresh_plm_links.description: Force a fresh PLM scan instead of reusing a result from the last hour. Optional, defaults to false.
